issue: The SetPO stage was matched, but its parents were not: seed 0 started from a 256-step RBEE run over 512 available groups, while seeds 1 and 2 started from earlier 64-step RBEE runs over 32 cached groups.
impact: E001 cannot support a claim about seed stability of the full end-to-end pipeline. It remains a prospective stability audit of the SetPO stage on the three parents that happened to be available.
corrected_question: Does the fixed 64-step RelTwin-SetPO stage improve SpotSound-Bench when applied to the three available RBEE parents?
corrected_success_criterion: All three available-parent runs improve the official same-harness baseline and the hierarchical seed-record bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero.
reason: One seed regressed in mIoU and the hierarchical mIoU delta CI crossed zero.
follow_up: E002 repeats the complete RBEE-256 plus SetPO-64 pipeline under a matched seed protocol.
audit_rule: The original protocol is preserved verbatim; this file does not rewrite its pre-result wording.
